lines.text: Many learners say: My house is near from here.
Better: My house is near here.
Near here! The bank is near here.

data.wrong: My house is near from here.

native.tip: Kita bilang “dekat dari sini”, tapi bahasa Inggris tidak pakai from: near here.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “My house is near from here.” 😅 Setelah near, jangan tambah from: “My house is near here.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “here”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “My house is near here.” Lalu ganti dengan tempat yang dekat dari rumahmu. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “dekat dari sini”, but English does not use from: near here.
en.caption: Ever say this? “My house is near from here.” 😅 After near, do not add from: “My house is near here.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
